About Organization

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is a constitutional body in India that is responsible for conducting various exams for recruitment to the civil services and other allied services.

The UPSC is headquartered in New Delhi and is headed by a chairman and a team of members.

About the Programme

The UPSC Combined Defence Service CDS II Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment exam conducted by the UPSC for the selection of candidates for the Indian Military Academy, Indian Naval Academy, Air Force Academy, and Officers Training Academy.

The exam is conducted twice a year, and the selected candidates are trained at the respective academies before being commissioned into the armed forces.
